env.buildPhase:
runHook preBuild
cargo --version
mkdir -p "$out"
if [ -d target ]; then
  chmod -R u+w target
  find target -name '.cargo*lock' -delete
fi
cargo nextest --version
cargo nextest archive \
  --cargo-profile ci-optim \
  --offline -p feynkit-generator \
  -E 'package(feynkit-generator)' \
  --profile ci_gammaloop \
  --archive-file "$out/gammaloop-nextest-feynkit-feynkit-generator.tar.zst"

runHook postBuild
env.configurePhase:
runHook preConfigure
echo default configurePhase, nothing to do
runHook postConfigure
env.name: gammaloop-nextest-binaries-feynkit-feynkit-generator-0.1.0

# archives share compiled libraries without retaining those large caches.

  rm -rf "${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-target}/${CARGO_PROFILE}/incremental"
fi

env.postBuild:
# Query caches have their own output in stateful test producers. Other
# archives share compiled libraries without retaining those large caches.
if [ -z "${incremental:-}" ]; then
  rm -rf "${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-target}/${CARGO_PROFILE}/incremental"
fi
# Consumers need compiled dependencies, not their rustc query caches.
# Keep compiler state in a separate output so the normal Crane delta
# archive and downstream merges never inherit ancestors' state.
mkdir -p ci-incremental-target/ci-optim
if [ -d target/ci-optim/incremental ]; then
  mv target/ci-optim/incremental ci-incremental-target/ci-optim/
fi
# Rustc creates new session paths with inherited epoch-1 hardlinks.
# Crane's mtime-only deltas would omit these newly named files.
doCompressAndInstallFullArchive=1 compressAndInstallCargoArtifactsDir \
  "$incremental" ci-incremental-target ""

make_target_writable() {
  chmod -R u+w target
}

unpack_artifact() {
  local artifact="$1"

  if [ -d "$artifact" ] && [ -f "$artifact/target.tar.zst" ]; then
    artifact="$artifact/target.tar.zst"
  elif [ -d "$artifact" ] && [ -d "$artifact/target" ]; then
    artifact="$artifact/target"
  fi

  if [ -f "$artifact" ]; then
    if [ -e "$artifact.prev" ] || [ -L "$artifact.prev" ]; then
      unpack_artifact "$(realpath "$artifact.prev")"
    fi
    make_target_writable
    zstd -d "$artifact" --stdout | tar --no-same-permissions -x -C target
    make_target_writable
  elif [ -d "$artifact" ]; then
    make_target_writable
    rsync -a --chmod=u+w "$artifact/" target/
    make_target_writable
  else
    echo "unsupported cargo artifact path: $artifact" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

env.preBuild:
# Compressed inheritance also needs Cargo's writable, fresh lock files.
mkdir -p target
find target -name '.cargo*lock' -delete
# Cargo feature anchors can compile dummy workspace units. Keep only
# artifacts that are intended to be reused by later derivations.
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/feynkit_generator
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/feynkit_generator.d
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/feynkit_generator-*
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/libfeynkit_generator.*
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/libfeynkit_generator-*
rm -f target/ci-optim/feynkit_generator
rm -f target/ci-optim/feynkit_generator.d
rm -f target/ci-optim/libfeynkit_generator.*
rm -f target/ci-optim/libfeynkit_generator-*

# Match the whole hash so stripping feynkit preserves feynkit-cff.
for artifact in target/ci-optim/{.fingerprint,build}/feynkit-generator-*; do
  if [[ "${artifact##*/}" =~ ^feynkit-generator-[0-9a-f]+$ ]]; then
    rm -rf "$artifact"
  fi
done

# Match the whole hash so stripping feynkit preserves feynkit-cff.
for artifact in target/ci-optim/{.fingerprint,build}/feynkit_generator-*; do
  if [[ "${artifact##*/}" =~ ^feynkit_generator-[0-9a-f]+$ ]]; then
    rm -rf "$artifact"
  fi
done

env.postBuild:
# Query caches have their own output in stateful test producers. Other
# archives share compiled libraries without retaining those large caches.
if [ -z "${incremental:-}" ]; then
  rm -rf "${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-target}/${CARGO_PROFILE}/incremental"
fi
# Consumers need compiled dependencies, not their rustc query caches.
# Keep compiler state in a separate output so the normal Crane delta
# archive and downstream merges never inherit ancestors' state.
mkdir -p ci-incremental-target/ci-optim
if [ -d target/ci-optim/incremental ]; then
  mv target/ci-optim/incremental ci-incremental-target/ci-optim/
fi
# Rustc creates new session paths with inherited epoch-1 hardlinks.
# Crane's mtime-only deltas would omit these newly named files.
doCompressAndInstallFullArchive=1 compressAndInstallCargoArtifactsDir \
  "$incremental" ci-incremental-target ""

env.postBuild:
# Query caches have their own output in stateful test producers. Other
# archives share compiled libraries without retaining those large caches.
if [ -z "${incremental:-}" ]; then
  rm -rf "${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-target}/${CARGO_PROFILE}/incremental"
fi
# Consumers need compiled dependencies, not their rustc query caches.
# Keep compiler state in a separate output so the normal Crane delta
# archive and downstream merges never inherit ancestors' state.
mkdir -p ci-incremental-target/ci-optim
if [ -d target/ci-optim/incremental ]; then
  mv target/ci-optim/incremental ci-incremental-target/ci-optim/
fi
# Rustc creates new session paths with inherited epoch-1 hardlinks.
# Crane's mtime-only deltas would omit these newly named files.
doCompressAndInstallFullArchive=1 compressAndInstallCargoArtifactsDir \
  "$incremental" ci-incremental-target ""

env.preBuild:
# Compressed inheritance also needs Cargo's writable, fresh lock files.
mkdir -p target
find target -name '.cargo*lock' -delete
# Cargo feature anchors can compile dummy workspace units. Keep only
# artifacts that are intended to be reused by later derivations.
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/feynkit_graph
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/feynkit_graph.d
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/feynkit_graph-*
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/libfeynkit_graph.*
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/libfeynkit_graph-*
rm -f target/ci-optim/feynkit_graph
rm -f target/ci-optim/feynkit_graph.d
rm -f target/ci-optim/libfeynkit_graph.*
rm -f target/ci-optim/libfeynkit_graph-*

# Match the whole hash so stripping feynkit preserves feynkit-cff.
for artifact in target/ci-optim/{.fingerprint,build}/feynkit-graph-*; do
  if [[ "${artifact##*/}" =~ ^feynkit-graph-[0-9a-f]+$ ]]; then
    rm -rf "$artifact"
  fi
done

# Match the whole hash so stripping feynkit preserves feynkit-cff.
for artifact in target/ci-optim/{.fingerprint,build}/feynkit_graph-*; do
  if [[ "${artifact##*/}" =~ ^feynkit_graph-[0-9a-f]+$ ]]; then
    rm -rf "$artifact"
  fi
done

env.buildPhase:
runHook preBuild
cargo --version
cargoWithProfile build --offline -p gammaloop-ci-consumer-feynkit-generator -p gammaloop-workspace-hack --features symbolica/tracing_max_level_info
runHook postBuild
env.configurePhase:
runHook preConfigure
echo default configurePhase, nothing to do
runHook postConfigure

env.preBuild:
# Compressed inheritance also needs Cargo's writable, fresh lock files.
mkdir -p target
find target -name '.cargo*lock' -delete
# Cargo feature anchors can compile dummy workspace units. Keep only
# artifacts that are intended to be reused by later derivations.
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/symbolica_notation
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/symbolica_notation.d
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/symbolica_notation-*
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/libsymbolica_notation.*
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/libsymbolica_notation-*
rm -f target/ci-optim/symbolica_notation
rm -f target/ci-optim/symbolica_notation.d
rm -f target/ci-optim/libsymbolica_notation.*
rm -f target/ci-optim/libsymbolica_notation-*

# Match the whole hash so stripping feynkit preserves feynkit-cff.
for artifact in target/ci-optim/{.fingerprint,build}/symbolica-notation-*; do
  if [[ "${artifact##*/}" =~ ^symbolica-notation-[0-9a-f]+$ ]]; then
    rm -rf "$artifact"
  fi
done

# Match the whole hash so stripping feynkit preserves feynkit-cff.
for artifact in target/ci-optim/{.fingerprint,build}/symbolica_notation-*; do
  if [[ "${artifact##*/}" =~ ^symbolica_notation-[0-9a-f]+$ ]]; then
    rm -rf "$artifact"
  fi
done

runHook preBuild
cargo --version
cargoWithProfile build --offline -p gammaloop-ci-consumer-idenso -p gammaloop-workspace-hack --features symbolica/tracing_max_level_info
runHook postBuild

env.preBuild:
# Compressed inheritance also needs Cargo's writable, fresh lock files.
mkdir -p target
find target -name '.cargo*lock' -delete
# Cargo feature anchors can compile dummy workspace units. Keep only
# artifacts that are intended to be reused by later derivations.
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/spenso
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/spenso.d
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/spenso-*
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/libspenso.*
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/libspenso-*
rm -f target/ci-optim/spenso
rm -f target/ci-optim/spenso.d
rm -f target/ci-optim/libspenso.*
rm -f target/ci-optim/libspenso-*

# Match the whole hash so stripping feynkit preserves feynkit-cff.
for artifact in target/ci-optim/{.fingerprint,build}/spenso-*; do
  if [[ "${artifact##*/}" =~ ^spenso-[0-9a-f]+$ ]]; then
    rm -rf "$artifact"
  fi
done

env.buildPhase:
runHook preBuild
cargo --version
cargoWithProfile build --offline -p gammaloop-ci-consumer-linnest -p gammaloop-workspace-hack --features symbolica/tracing_max_level_info
runHook postBuild
env.configurePhase:
runHook preConfigure
echo default configurePhase, nothing to do
runHook postConfigure

env.preBuild:
# Compressed inheritance also needs Cargo's writable, fresh lock files.
mkdir -p target
find target -name '.cargo*lock' -delete
# Cargo feature anchors can compile dummy workspace units. Keep only
# artifacts that are intended to be reused by later derivations.
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/linnest
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/linnest.d
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/linnest-*
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/liblinnest.*
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/liblinnest-*
rm -f target/ci-optim/linnest
rm -f target/ci-optim/linnest.d
rm -f target/ci-optim/liblinnest.*
rm -f target/ci-optim/liblinnest-*

# Match the whole hash so stripping feynkit preserves feynkit-cff.
for artifact in target/ci-optim/{.fingerprint,build}/linnest-*; do
  if [[ "${artifact##*/}" =~ ^linnest-[0-9a-f]+$ ]]; then
    rm -rf "$artifact"
  fi
done

env.buildPhase:
runHook preBuild
cargo --version
cargoWithProfile build --locked -p gammaloop-workspace-hack --features symbolica/tracing_max_level_info
runHook postBuild
env.configurePhase:
runHook preConfigure
echo default configurePhase, nothing to do
runHook postConfigure

env.postBuild:
# Query caches have their own output in stateful test producers. Other
# archives share compiled libraries without retaining those large caches.
if [ -z "${incremental:-}" ]; then
  rm -rf "${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-target}/${CARGO_PROFILE}/incremental"
fi
# Cargo feature anchors can compile dummy workspace units. Keep only
# artifacts that are intended to be reused by later derivations.
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/alphal00p_docs_builder
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/alphal00p_docs_builder.d
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/alphal00p_docs_builder-*
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/libalphal00p_docs_builder.*

rm -f target/ci-optim/alphal00p_docs_builder.d
rm -f target/ci-optim/libalphal00p_docs_builder.*
rm -f target/ci-optim/libalphal00p_docs_builder-*

# Match the whole hash so stripping feynkit preserves feynkit-cff.
for artifact in target/ci-optim/{.fingerprint,build}/alphal00p-docs-builder-*; do
  if [[ "${artifact##*/}" =~ ^alphal00p-docs-builder-[0-9a-f]+$ ]]; then
    rm -rf "$artifact"

done

# Query caches have their own output in stateful test producers. Other
# archives share compiled libraries without retaining those large caches.
if [ -z "${incremental:-}" ]; then
  rm -rf "${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-target}/${CARGO_PROFILE}/incremental"

# Keep compiler state in a separate output so the normal Crane delta
# archive and downstream merges never inherit ancestors' state.
mkdir -p ci-incremental-target/ci-optim
if [ -d target/ci-optim/incremental ]; then
  mv target/ci-optim/incremental ci-incremental-target/ci-optim/
fi
# Rustc creates new session paths with inherited epoch-1 hardlinks.

doCompressAndInstallFullArchive=1 compressAndInstallCargoArtifactsDir \
  "$incremental" ci-incremental-target ""

# Compressed inheritance also needs Cargo's writable, fresh lock files.
mkdir -p target
find target -name '.cargo*lock' -delete

# artifacts that are intended to be reused by later derivations.
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/feynkit_model
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/feynkit_model.d
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/feynkit_model-*
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/libfeynkit_model.*
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/libfeynkit_model-*
rm -f target/ci-optim/feynkit_model
rm -f target/ci-optim/feynkit_model.d
rm -f target/ci-optim/libfeynkit_model.*
rm -f target/ci-optim/libfeynkit_model-*

# Match the whole hash so stripping feynkit preserves feynkit-cff.
for artifact in target/ci-optim/{.fingerprint,build}/feynkit-model-*; do
  if [[ "${artifact##*/}" =~ ^feynkit-model-[0-9a-f]+$ ]]; then

  if [[ "${artifact##*/}" =~ ^feynkit_model-[0-9a-f]+$ ]]; then

env.postBuild:
# Query caches have their own output in stateful test producers. Other
# archives share compiled libraries without retaining those large caches.
if [ -z "${incremental:-}" ]; then
  rm -rf "${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-target}/${CARGO_PROFILE}/incremental"
fi
# Consumers need compiled dependencies, not their rustc query caches.
# Keep compiler state in a separate output so the normal Crane delta
# archive and downstream merges never inherit ancestors' state.
mkdir -p ci-incremental-target/ci-optim
if [ -d target/ci-optim/incremental ]; then
  mv target/ci-optim/incremental ci-incremental-target/ci-optim/
fi
# Rustc creates new session paths with inherited epoch-1 hardlinks.
# Crane's mtime-only deltas would omit these newly named files.
doCompressAndInstallFullArchive=1 compressAndInstallCargoArtifactsDir \
  "$incremental" ci-incremental-target ""

# Compressed inheritance also needs Cargo's writable, fresh lock files.
mkdir -p target
find target -name '.cargo*lock' -delete

env.buildCommand:
mkdir -p target

make_target_writable() {
  chmod -R u+w target
}

unpack_artifact() {
  local artifact="$1"

  if [ -d "$artifact" ] && [ -f "$artifact/target.tar.zst" ]; then
    artifact="$artifact/target.tar.zst"
  elif [ -d "$artifact" ] && [ -d "$artifact/target" ]; then
    artifact="$artifact/target"
  fi

  if [ -f "$artifact" ]; then
    if [ -e "$artifact.prev" ] || [ -L "$artifact.prev" ]; then
      unpack_artifact "$(realpath "$artifact.prev")"
    fi
    make_target_writable
    zstd -d "$artifact" --stdout | tar --no-same-permissions -x -C target
    make_target_writable
  elif [ -d "$artifact" ]; then
    make_target_writable
    rsync -a --chmod=u+w "$artifact/" target/
    make_target_writable
  else
    echo "unsupported cargo artifact path: $artifact" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

unpack_artifact() {
  local artifact="$1"

  if [ -d "$artifact" ] && [ -f "$artifact/target.tar.zst" ]; then
    artifact="$artifact/target.tar.zst"
  elif [ -d "$artifact" ] && [ -d "$artifact/target" ]; then
    artifact="$artifact/target"
  fi

  if [ -f "$artifact" ]; then
    if [ -e "$artifact.prev" ] || [ -L "$artifact.prev" ]; then
      unpack_artifact "$(realpath "$artifact.prev")"
    fi
    make_target_writable
    zstd -d "$artifact" --stdout | tar --no-same-permissions -x -C target
    make_target_writable
  elif [ -d "$artifact" ]; then
    make_target_writable
    rsync -a --chmod=u+w "$artifact/" target/
    make_target_writable
  else
    echo "unsupported cargo artifact path: $artifact" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

structuredAttrs.text:
[package]
name = "gammaloop-ci-consumer-symbolica-utils"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"
publish = false

[lib]
path = "src/lib.rs"

[dependencies]
pyo3 = { workspace = true, features = ["anyhow","auto-initialize","eyre","macros","multiple-pymethods"] }

env.buildCommand:
mkdir -p target

make_target_writable() {
  chmod -R u+w target
}

unpack_artifact() {
  local artifact="$1"

  if [ -d "$artifact" ] && [ -f "$artifact/target.tar.zst" ]; then
    artifact="$artifact/target.tar.zst"
  elif [ -d "$artifact" ] && [ -d "$artifact/target" ]; then
    artifact="$artifact/target"
  fi

  if [ -f "$artifact" ]; then
    if [ -e "$artifact.prev" ] || [ -L "$artifact.prev" ]; then
      unpack_artifact "$(realpath "$artifact.prev")"
    fi
    make_target_writable
    zstd -d "$artifact" --stdout | tar --no-same-permissions -x -C target
    make_target_writable
  elif [ -d "$artifact" ]; then
    make_target_writable
    rsync -a --chmod=u+w "$artifact/" target/
    make_target_writable
  else
    echo "unsupported cargo artifact path: $artifact" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

env.postBuild:
# Query caches have their own output in stateful test producers. Other
# archives share compiled libraries without retaining those large caches.
if [ -z "${incremental:-}" ]; then
  rm -rf "${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-target}/${CARGO_PROFILE}/incremental"
fi
# Cargo feature anchors can compile dummy workspace units. Keep only
# artifacts that are intended to be reused by later derivations.
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/alphal00p_docs_builder
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/alphal00p_docs_builder.d
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/alphal00p_docs_builder-*
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/libalphal00p_docs_builder.*
rm -f target/ci-optim/deps/libalphal00p_docs_builder-*
rm -f target/ci-optim/alphal00p_docs_builder
rm -f target/ci-optim/alphal00p_docs_builder.d
rm -f target/ci-optim/libalphal00p_docs_builder.*
rm -f target/ci-optim/libalphal00p_docs_builder-*

# Match the whole hash so stripping feynkit preserves feynkit-cff.
for artifact in target/ci-optim/{.fingerprint,build}/alphal00p-docs-builder-*; do
  if [[ "${artifact##*/}" =~ ^alphal00p-docs-builder-[0-9a-f]+$ ]]; then
    rm -rf "$artifact"
  fi

env.preBuild:
# Compressed inheritance also needs Cargo's writable, fresh lock files.
mkdir -p target
find target -name '.cargo*lock' -delete

env.buildCommand:
mkdir -p target

make_target_writable() {
  chmod -R u+w target
}

unpack_artifact() {
  local artifact="$1"

  if [ -d "$artifact" ] && [ -f "$artifact/target.tar.zst" ]; then
    artifact="$artifact/target.tar.zst"
  elif [ -d "$artifact" ] && [ -d "$artifact/target" ]; then
    artifact="$artifact/target"
  fi

  if [ -f "$artifact" ]; then
    if [ -e "$artifact.prev" ] || [ -L "$artifact.prev" ]; then
      unpack_artifact "$(realpath "$artifact.prev")"
    fi
    make_target_writable
    zstd -d "$artifact" --stdout | tar --no-same-permissions -x -C target
    make_target_writable
  elif [ -d "$artifact" ]; then
    make_target_writable
    rsync -a --chmod=u+w "$artifact/" target/
    make_target_writable
  else
    echo "unsupported cargo artifact path: $artifact" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

env.postBuild:
# Query caches have their own output in stateful test producers. Other
# archives share compiled libraries without retaining those large caches.
if [ -z "${incremental:-}" ]; then
  rm -rf "${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-target}/${CARGO_PROFILE}/incremental"
fi
# Consumers need compiled dependencies, not their rustc query caches.
# Keep compiler state in a separate output so the normal Crane delta
# archive and downstream merges never inherit ancestors' state.
mkdir -p ci-incremental-target/ci-optim
if [ -d target/ci-optim/incremental ]; then
  mv target/ci-optim/incremental ci-incremental-target/ci-optim/
fi
# Rustc creates new session paths with inherited epoch-1 hardlinks.
# Crane's mtime-only deltas would omit these newly named files.
doCompressAndInstallFullArchive=1 compressAndInstallCargoArtifactsDir \
  "$incremental" ci-incremental-target ""

  rm -rf "${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-target}/${CARGO_PROFILE}/incremental"

# Keep compiler state in a separate output so the normal Crane delta
# archive and downstream merges never inherit ancestors' state.

  mv target/ci-optim/incremental ci-incremental-target/ci-optim/

# Compressed inheritance also needs Cargo's writable, fresh lock files.
mkdir -p target
find target -name '.cargo*lock' -delete

structuredAttrs.buildCommand:
target=$out$destination
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$target")"

if [ -e "$textPath" ]; then
  mv "$textPath" "$target"
else
  printf "%s" "$text" > "$target"
fi

if [ -n "$executable" ]; then
  chmod +x "$target"
fi

eval "$checkPhase"
structuredAttrs.name: gammaloop-ci-consumer-symbolica-utils-Cargo.toml
structuredAttrs.text:
[package]
name = "gammaloop-ci-consumer-symbolica-utils"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"
publish = false

[lib]
path = "src/lib.rs"

[dependencies]
pyo3 = { workspace = true, features = ["anyhow","auto-initialize","eyre","macros","multiple-pymethods"] }

pyo3-stub-gen = { workspace = true, features = ["infer_signature","numpy"] }

env.buildPhase:
runHook preBuild
cargo --version
cargoWithProfile build --offline -p gammaloop-ci-consumer-feynkit-graph -p gammaloop-workspace-hack --features symbolica/tracing_max_level_info
runHook postBuild
env.configurePhase:
runHook preConfigure
echo default configurePhase, nothing to do
runHook postConfigure

env.postBuild:
# Query caches have their own output in stateful test producers. Other
# archives share compiled libraries without retaining those large caches.
if [ -z "${incremental:-}" ]; then
  rm -rf "${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-target}/${CARGO_PROFILE}/incremental"
fi
# Consumers need compiled dependencies, not their rustc query caches.
# Keep compiler state in a separate output so the normal Crane delta
# archive and downstream merges never inherit ancestors' state.
mkdir -p ci-incremental-target/ci-optim
if [ -d target/ci-optim/incremental ]; then
  mv target/ci-optim/incremental ci-incremental-target/ci-optim/
fi
# Rustc creates new session paths with inherited epoch-1 hardlinks.
# Crane's mtime-only deltas would omit these newly named files.
doCompressAndInstallFullArchive=1 compressAndInstallCargoArtifactsDir \
  "$incremental" ci-incremental-target ""

# Query caches have their own output in stateful test producers. Other
# archives share compiled libraries without retaining those large caches.
if [ -z "${incremental:-}" ]; then
  rm -rf "${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-target}/${CARGO_PROFILE}/incremental"
fi
# Consumers need compiled dependencies, not their rustc query caches.
# Keep compiler state in a separate output so the normal Crane delta
# archive and downstream merges never inherit ancestors' state.
mkdir -p ci-incremental-target/ci-optim
if [ -d target/ci-optim/incremental ]; then
  mv target/ci-optim/incremental ci-incremental-target/ci-optim/
fi
# Rustc creates new session paths with inherited epoch-1 hardlinks.
# Crane's mtime-only deltas would omit these newly named files.
doCompressAndInstallFullArchive=1 compressAndInstallCargoArtifactsDir \
  "$incremental" ci-incremental-target ""

env.postBuild:
# Query caches have their own output in stateful test producers. Other
# archives share compiled libraries without retaining those large caches.
if [ -z "${incremental:-}" ]; then
  rm -rf "${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-target}/${CARGO_PROFILE}/incremental"
fi
# Consumers need compiled dependencies, not their rustc query caches.
# Keep compiler state in a separate output so the normal Crane delta
# archive and downstream merges never inherit ancestors' state.
mkdir -p ci-incremental-target/ci-optim
if [ -d target/ci-optim/incremental ]; then
  mv target/ci-optim/incremental ci-incremental-target/ci-optim/
fi
# Rustc creates new session paths with inherited epoch-1 hardlinks.
# Crane's mtime-only deltas would omit these newly named files.
doCompressAndInstallFullArchive=1 compressAndInstallCargoArtifactsDir \
  "$incremental" ci-incremental-target ""

env.postBuild:
# Query caches have their own output in stateful test producers. Other
# archives share compiled libraries without retaining those large caches.
if [ -z "${incremental:-}" ]; then
  rm -rf "${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-target}/${CARGO_PROFILE}/incremental"
fi
# Consumers need compiled dependencies, not their rustc query caches.
# Keep compiler state in a separate output so the normal Crane delta
# archive and downstream merges never inherit ancestors' state.
mkdir -p ci-incremental-target/ci-optim
if [ -d target/ci-optim/incremental ]; then
  mv target/ci-optim/incremental ci-incremental-target/ci-optim/
fi
# Rustc creates new session paths with inherited epoch-1 hardlinks.
# Crane's mtime-only deltas would omit these newly named files.
doCompressAndInstallFullArchive=1 compressAndInstallCargoArtifactsDir \
  "$incremental" ci-incremental-target ""

env.postBuild:
# Query caches have their own output in stateful test producers. Other
# archives share compiled libraries without retaining those large caches.
if [ -z "${incremental:-}" ]; then
  rm -rf "${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-target}/${CARGO_PROFILE}/incremental"
fi
# Consumers need compiled dependencies, not their rustc query caches.
# Keep compiler state in a separate output so the normal Crane delta
# archive and downstream merges never inherit ancestors' state.
mkdir -p ci-incremental-target/ci-optim
if [ -d target/ci-optim/incremental ]; then
  mv target/ci-optim/incremental ci-incremental-target/ci-optim/
fi
# Rustc creates new session paths with inherited epoch-1 hardlinks.
# Crane's mtime-only deltas would omit these newly named files.
doCompressAndInstallFullArchive=1 compressAndInstallCargoArtifactsDir \
  "$incremental" ci-incremental-target ""

env.postBuild:
# Query caches have their own output in stateful test producers. Other
# archives share compiled libraries without retaining those large caches.
if [ -z "${incremental:-}" ]; then
  rm -rf "${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-target}/${CARGO_PROFILE}/incremental"
fi
# Consumers need compiled dependencies, not their rustc query caches.
# Keep compiler state in a separate output so the normal Crane delta
# archive and downstream merges never inherit ancestors' state.
mkdir -p ci-incremental-target/ci-optim
if [ -d target/ci-optim/incremental ]; then
  mv target/ci-optim/incremental ci-incremental-target/ci-optim/
fi
# Rustc creates new session paths with inherited epoch-1 hardlinks.
# Crane's mtime-only deltas would omit these newly named files.
doCompressAndInstallFullArchive=1 compressAndInstallCargoArtifactsDir \
  "$incremental" ci-incremental-target ""
